strongest_angle: The World Meteorological Organization and regional Pacific forums report that the strengthening 2026 El Niño event is causing severe below-normal rainfall from Palau to the Marshall Islands, with Fiji reporting critical water shortages affecting thousands of people.

key_facts.fact: The World Meteorological Organization announced in November 2026 that a strengthening El Niño is causing below-normal rainfall from Palau to the Marshall Islands.
Fiji's Minister for Meteorological Services Ro Filipe Tuisawau reported in Parliament that 19 of the 44 monitored water sources are at critical levels.
About 24,600 people in Fiji are on intermittent water supply or relying on water carting due to the deepening El Niño drought.
The 19th Pacific Islands Climate and Ocean Forum stated that the 2026 El Niño is likely to exceed the strength of all previous events recorded since 1950.
